decisions.reason: Despite some sunk investment and a public launch, this decorative devore line is a relatively fashion-sensitive extension with limited strategic centrality, so management would be somewhat willing to discontinue it once temporary excuses for weak uptake have run their course.

The firm may persist for a time because it already promoted the product, but as a niche transparent burnout decorative fabric close to existing offerings it is easier to prune if sales have disappointed.
Management’s escalation tendency supports some continuation, yet this burnout decorative fabric appears sufficiently overlapping and non-core that it is slightly more likely than not to be removed.

Because this velour-like upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm’s established upholstery business, stocked-service model, and prior launch commitment, management is likely to keep backing it and attribute any weakness to temporary market conditions.

The flame-retardant inbetween fabric fits the firm’s core offer while adding a useful functional specification, so prior investment and strategic fit make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

This lining fabric is a practical adjacent product that complements the firm’s sewing and sample capabilities, and the management’s commitment bias makes it inclined to retain it unless results are clearly poor.
